requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single hand-painted, volumetric Victoria 3 TECHNOLOGY icon, not a flat production-method pictogram.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Replace the entire parchment scroll/charter with ONE closed thick leather-bound book and place the existing royal crown ON TOP OF THE BOOK. The crown must rest physically on the upper book cover, not sit beside the book or float. Remove the scroll, curled parchment, wax seal, ribbons and ink marks completely. Exactly two objects: one book and one crown.
Preserve the crown's identifiable design: broad patinated gold arches, deep red velvet interior and simple gold orb on top; retain its natural gold/red colors and painted brushwork. The book is plain dark burgundy-brown aged leather, with a clearly visible pale ivory page block and a simple rounded spine. No lettering, title, numbers, heraldic emblems or decorative script on the cover or spine. A three-quarter slightly elevated view shows the front page block, book thickness, upper cover and crown resting on it. Keep the crown and book balanced as a compact centered group, large and recognizable at 48 and 64 pixels. No additional objects.
Keep the original restrained painterly material treatment and short natural highlights; visibly painted volume rather than glossy 3D, photograph, cartoon sticker, cut-paper graphic or sepia monochrome. No blue tint. Genuine transparent alpha background and open gaps, square high-resolution raster at least 1024x1024 with modest transparent margins and all four corners transparent. No tabletop, floor, background scene, cast shadow outside the objects, frame, circular medallion, badge, words, watermark or UI decoration. Output just the single revised icon.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single hand-painted, volumetric Victoria 3 TECHNOLOGY icon, not a flat production-method pictogram.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Make ONLY this addition: attach one clearly recognizable circular pleated tricolor cockade to the visible folded lower band of the red Phrygian liberty cap. The cockade has a muted blue center, ivory-white middle ring and red outer pleated ring, no inscription and no long ribbons. Give it enough size to remain visible at 48 and 64 pixels while keeping it subordinate to the cap. Render its fabric and folds in the same painterly style as the existing cap.
IMPORTANT: KEEP THE WOODEN STAFF / HAMPE unchanged. The user explicitly wants the staff retained. Do not remove, shorten, recolor or redesign it. Preserve the red wool cap shape, forward-drooping tip, broad folds, color, material, position, lighting, transparent silhouette, crop and the visible brown wooden staff. No new cap, no redesign of the original image beyond adding the cockade. Keep the compact centered composition.
Preserve the original hand-painted volumetric object treatment, matte wool grain, restrained highlights and natural red/brown palette; no glossy 3D render, photo, flat PM symbol or cut-paper style. Keep the genuinely transparent alpha background and all four corners transparent; square raster at least 1024x1024. No floor, tabletop, mannequin, head, hand, flag, other props, new text, watermark, medallion, scene or opaque background. Output just the single revised icon.
